record.question: Which of the following scenarios correctly demonstrates a secure implementation of Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)?
options: A user logs in using a password and then answers a security question stored on the same server
A user enters a password and receives a one-time code on a registered mobile device generated via a separate authentication channel
A user logs in using only biometric authentication stored locally on the device
A user uses two different passwords for the same account
